evals.name: standard-plan-review
evals.prompt: Use the peer-plan-review skill with reviewer codex gpt-5.6-sol high to critique my implementation plan at docs/plans/migration-plan.md before I start coding.
evals.expected_output: The agent validates the plan path, normalizes arguments to reviewer 'codex', model 'gpt-5.6-sol', effort 'high', launches the background reviewer with ppr_launch.sh, extracts structured findings ([B1], [N1]), independently verifies reviewer claims against the repo, and reports the verdict.

assertions.description: Agent performs preflight self-check or validates reviewer binary availability
Prompt includes Pass A / Pass B structure and structured output template ([B1], [N1], VERDICT)
Agent verifies reviewer claims against the codebase before editing the plan

evals.name: adversarial-plan-review
evals.prompt:
Run a skeptical, adversarial peer review on this payment service redesign plan using claude-code opus --stance adversarial.

Plan is at docs/plans/payments-redesign.md
evals.expected_output: The agent loads references/adversarial.md, sets an aggressive critical stance, instructs the reviewer to actively attempt to break the plan, surface edge-case data corruptions, race conditions, and single-point-of-failure risks.

assertions.description: Agent loads references/adversarial.md for adversarial prompt instructions
Prompt explicitly directs reviewer to falsify assumptions and search for failure modes
Blocking issues require concrete failure mechanisms rather than stylistic preferences

evals.name: domain-context-two-pass-review
evals.prompt:
Review this distributed ingestion pipeline plan using peer-plan-review codex high. Include domain context criteria for zero-downtime schema migrations, backpressure handling, and idempotent event retries.

Plan is at docs/plans/ingestion-pipeline.md
evals.expected_output: The agent formats domain criteria as 3 to 6 testable bullets in the prompt, instructs the reviewer to run a two-pass critique (Pass A: independent critique, Pass B: domain criteria evaluation), and checks each criterion against the line-numbered plan.

assertions.description: Prompt includes ## Domain context block with 3 to 6 testable bullet criteria
Output schema requires Pass A (independent) and Pass B (domain criteria)
Plan file is presented to reviewer with line numbers (cat -n)

evals.name: multiround-revision-resume
evals.prompt: Here is my updated plan addressing the round 1 blocking findings (fixed B1 retry limit, added B2 circuit breaker). Resume the review session for review ID 75e32e48caa8 with codex to verify convergence.
evals.expected_output: The agent derives session paths, constructs round 2 prompt with prior findings and author responses, passes --resume flag to ppr_launch.sh, monitors session ID continuity, and checks for VERDICT: APPROVED or VERDICT: REVISE.

assertions.description: ppr_launch.sh or run_review.py is invoked with --resume
Round 2 prompt explicitly includes prior round findings and how the author responded
Agent handles resume degradation gracefully if session_id is missing without breaking execution
